name: tms320f28069
description: TI TMS320F28069 (Piccolo: C28x + FPU32 + VCU-I + CLA, 90 MHz): TI C2000 code generation tools (cl2000, EABI) and C2000Ware headers, Renode CPU.C2000 core

image.notes: word addressed: word address a is bus address 2a (e.g. SysCtrlRegs at 0x7010 -> 0xE020). LoadTIProgram loads the ELF segments and sets the PC to the entry; 'cpu LoadTIProgram @f.out false' then 'cpu Reset' starts through the generated boot ROM (flash entry 0x3F7FF6). Device headers: F2806x_Device.h (register structs, not #define SFRs).

renode.notes: reads of word address a: 'sysbus ReadWord 2a' / 'ReadDoubleWord 2a' (32-bit values are low word first). Peripheral docs: tools/c2000/PERIPHERALS.md in the Renode tree.

reference.simulator: none; the C28x/FPU/VCU and CLA decoders were checked against TI dis2000 over the opcode space, execution against host-compiled references and self-checking firmware (tools/c2000/tests)
